g.text: Precondition: the Manager is logged in.
Trigger: the Manager begins or continues planning a roster week.
1a. The published roster is shown read only. Changes go through
UC-06 Amend Published Roster. UC-04 ends.
4a. No eligible ambulance: this pass ends and the Manager
may select another shift or roster slot.
